cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Kill any running node
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pkill -f 'tsx src' 2>&1 || true")
time.sleep(2)
# Try to build and run docker
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && docker-compose up -d --build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())
time.sleep(30)
# Check status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' 2>&1")
print("Running:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
